scope: Exploratory; unknown pretraining patient exposure; provided pancreas regions; no independent-test claim

identity_comparison.limitation: Retained control handoff only; final November5 KD arm-bound references/results not available in inspected local locations. Mac must bind both completed arms before matched claims.

metric_definitions.lesion_dice: 2*true_positive/(target_voxels+predicted_voxels); null when both counts are zero. Algebra checked for every saved row.
metric_definitions.aggregate_lesion_dice: Macro mean over all 36 reference-positive cases; checked against saved summary.
metric_definitions.true_positive: Saved overlapping lesion voxel count on native grid.
metric_definitions.case_detected: Any lesion true_positive voxels; checked against saved counts.
metric_definitions.false_alarm_any: Reference-empty case with predicted lesion voxels >0; checked.
metric_definitions.components: Reference/detected/predicted component counts copied; connectivity and matching details not declared in inspected JSON.
metric_definitions.size_band: Existing labels copied; numeric thresholds not declared in inspected JSON.
metric_definitions.volumes: Existing target/predicted volume_mm3 and voxel_mm3 copied.
metric_definitions.case_alert_50mm3: Separate saved alert boolean, not substituted for false_alarm_any.
